meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
"11:52 PM." On what date, and from whose document? Turn the screen, because a block of text arriving at once tells me how it was saved, not who wrote it.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale; I want the zero withdrawn in writing today, with confirmation that nothing about this is anywhere on his record. And I still want to know why it went in before anyone called me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

In our meeting you said you would remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero has been withdrawn and that nothing about this matter is on his record, along with an explanation of why the mark was entered before anyone contacted me. I asked for that confirmation in writing today, Tuesday, November 10.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: opening position; Hale offered to remove the zero, and she agreed to nothing, still demanding written withdrawal, a clean record and an explanation.
What moved her: nothing; the 11:52 PM version history was never dated or shown to her, and the offer to remove the zero "if that makes you happy" read as waffling, not evidence.
